dogecoin.text: Only the true dogecoin OGs remember wolong.

Love it or hate it, dogecoin is providing a gateway for millions of newbs into crypto. Its simply much tougher to explain a Solana or Curve Finance to them, but give them enough time, hopefully they'll find that information. I remember loving doge back in 2013 when I was new too.

It'll keep going up for the next few months probably, as dogecoin is heavily correlated with bitcoin, but you buy dogecoin when no one gives a shit about it. When no one is asking "should I buy doge?" The most recent time for that was spring-summer-fall of 2023. Not now.

Are you too late to dogecoin? IMO, as someone with a lot of dogecoin, the answer unfortunately is yes. Don't buy it. It will go up for a while still, but there are better memes to go after now. You buy doge during the year long consolidation pattern it exhibits after it crashes.

It's actually pretty horrifying how correlated dogecoin is with bitcoin. And I think bitcoin is going up forever. So....

Yea.
